schema: Audio-V native defect validation corpus v1
description: Labeled, natively decoded PCM controls for click/pop and stuck-sample regression. These deterministic synthetic fixtures validate detector behavior but are not a licensed real-world prevalence corpus.

cases.truth: one inserted 150 millisecond non-zero constant plateau

limitations: The fixtures are deterministic synthetic PCM decoded through the native FFmpeg path.
They do not estimate false-positive or false-negative rates on historical recordings, vinyl transfers, live captures, or damaged field recordings.
Detector findings remain Review evidence and never establish deterministic file corruption.
